$comment: Tracked files ./build.sh reads to produce its output. tools/build_stamp.py hashes these into config/build_stamp.json (stage 24), and CI recomputes the hash to catch output committed without a rebuild after an input changed. Patterns are pathlib globs from the repository root; each must match at least one file. canonical/ is not listed because it is untracked: the stamp cannot see a change to it. Build outputs are never inputs: config/store_ids.json (stage 1), config/authority_report.json (stage 4), config/reconciliation.json (stage 16), config/build_stamp.json (stage 24), docs/**, data/exports/**.
